You are hereby assigned operational command","parent_excerpt":"The United States High Commissioner for Austria shall continue to be the supreme United States authority in Austria","explanation":"C15 has superficially similar supreme-authority terminology and separates military matters, but it does not contain the child's assignment of operational command, preservation of routine command channels, or staffing authority."},{"child_excerpt":"Subject to overriding requirements of the Supreme Allied Commander, Europe, the missions, routine employment, training and administration of these forces will be handled through command channels heretofore existing.","parent_excerpt":"with respect to military matters ... the Commanding General, United States Forces in Austria, shall continue to receive instructions directly from the Joint Chiefs of Staff","explanation":"Both preserve an existing military chain of command within a larger authority structure, but the formulations allocate materially different authority and lack a sufficiently close operative sequence to establish reuse."},{"child_excerpt":"As President and Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the United States","parent_excerpt":"As President of the United States and as Commander-in-Chief","explanation":"C23 shares the addressee and a similar presidential-capacity phrase, but that phrase is routine and appears in a ceremonial letter of appreciation with no parallel command machinery."}]}
